resources.string: Camera is for scanning only. Images stay on your phone.
Point the camera at the Mobile pairing QR in Nexus Console.
Camera permission is needed to scan. Allow Camera for Nexus Mobile to continue, or cancel.
Could not open app permissions. Go to Settings → Apps → Nexus Mobile → Permissions → Camera.
Could not open the camera. Close other apps using it, check Camera access in system settings, then retry.
No camera is available on this device. Scan the pairing QR on a phone with a camera.
Could not open the built-in scanner. Restart Nexus Mobile and try again.
This is not a valid Nexus Mobile pairing QR. Scan the Mobile pairing QR from Nexus Console.
This pairing QR has expired. Generate a new QR in Nexus Console and scan again.
QR scan canceled. Your existing pairing is unchanged.
Allows Nexus agents to observe and control this Android device after explicit pairing.
Allows authorized agents to read your screen and control this phone. Only enable for a server you trust.
1. Open Nexus Mobile App info.\n2. If available, choose ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.\n3. Return here, then enable Device control.
Only approve for a trusted APK. Keep system security protections on.
Option missing? Your phone or administrator may restrict access.
Next: enable Nexus Mobile Control in Accessibility settings.
Could not open App info. Open Settings → Apps → Nexus Mobile manually, then look for “Allow restricted settings” in the ⋮ menu.
Could not open Accessibility settings. Open Settings → Accessibility manually and select Nexus Mobile Control. Your phone administrator may restrict this permission.
Still off. Enable Nexus Mobile Control in Accessibility, or use the help below.
Return here with Android Back. We check the actual permission. Labels may vary by phone.
Shows sync status and a Pause action. You can skip this.
Still off. Retry in Android settings, or skip for now.
Could not open notification settings. Open Settings → Apps → Nexus Mobile → Notifications, or continue without notifications.
Control is ready. Notifications are off.
Allow Camera to scan. You can cancel at any time.
Scan the Mobile pairing QR from Nexus Console.
Continue only if you trust this server.

Authorized agents can read your screen and control this phone. Pause sync before entering sensitive information.\n\nPasswords and sensitive fields are redacted where detected; this is not a privacy guarantee. Screenshots are only taken on request and blocked on protected screens.
Sync stops. The saved credential for %1$s is removed from this phone.
Could not save pairing securely. Try again.
Device control needs setup. Review permissions below.
Cloud is unreachable. Check your connection.
Pairing is no longer valid. Scan a new QR.
Share your screen with your Nexus browser. No audio or recording.
